# Category mapping: outcomes and interventions

**Generated automatically by `finalize_cohort` (`src/ctgov_pipeline/category_mapping_report.py`). Do not edit by hand:** it is rewritten on every rebuild, so the patterns and counts always match the code, `config/intervention_categories.yaml` and the included cohort.

Cohort: 824 included trials, 1,900 primary-outcome rows (extraction run `full_20261109_104453`, rules `conditions_field_v3`). Categories are descriptive aids for review only; they never include or exclude a trial or an outcome, and never replace the raw text.

## Outcome categories (`outcome_category`, `outcome_subcategory` in `primary_outcomes.csv`)

Each primary outcome gets one category. Rules run as one ordered list (the order of the table below, with the measure-name-only rules last); the **first rule with a matching pattern wins**; no match gives `other` with `outcome_category_review_flag = True`.

Patterns read the measure + description + time frame, except all `mechanistic` and `feasibility_acceptability` patterns and the patterns marked † , which read the **measure name only** (descriptions of clinical outcomes mention "fMRI", "enrollment", "adverse", "attend" or "consent" without being those outcomes; the † patterns are generic words, so they are tried last and cannot override a specific rule). Patterns are shown as readable regex fragments (`?` optional, `<n>` a number). "Most frequent detected instruments" comes from the separate `instruments_detected` lexicon column, not from these rules.

## Intervention categories (`intervention_categories` in `studies.csv`)

Multi-label, taxonomy v2.2.1: each trial gets every category matched by any **active** (non-comparator) arm, using the arm name, description and type. Comparator arms are detected from the arm **name** only and never contribute a category.

- `is_multimodal` (a category plus an active non-behavioral arm): 101 trials (12.3%). Non-behavioral arm types: pharmacological: DRUG, BIOLOGICAL, DIETARY SUPPLEMENT; device: DEVICE; procedural: PROCEDURE, RADIATION, GENETIC.
- Trials with at least one comparator arm: 131 (15.9%). Comparator arms never contribute categories.

**Comparator arm patterns** (arm name only): placebo, sham, wait-list, waiting list, usual care, standard care, standard of care, standard medical, typical care, business as usual, minimally enhanced usual care, treatment as usual, TAU, no intervention, no additional intervention, screening and outcome evaluation only, attention control, ^controls?$, ^control:, ^control group$, ^control arm$, ^control condition$, ^control intervention$, ^(passive\|active) control( intervention)?$, control group$, control arm$, control condition$, control intervention$, (education\|website\|activity) control( intervention)?$, -control$
